mapper.sql: inner join biz_member mb on mb.member_id = ${alias}.member_id and ifnull(mb.test_flag, '0') = '0'
mapper.select: select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayKey, count(*) as cnt from biz_member where ifnull(test_flag, '0') = '0' and create_time >= #{begin} and create_time < #{end} group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayKey, count(*) as cnt from biz_order o
where o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time < #{end} group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayKey, count(distinct o.member_id) as cnt from biz_order o
where o.create_time >= #{begin} and o.create_time < #{end} group by date_format(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')

select l.biz_type as bizType, m.phone, l.member_id as memberId, l.currency, l.amount, l.remark, l.create_time as createTime from biz_wallet_log l left join biz_member m on m.member_id = l.member_id where ifnull(m.test_flag, '0') = '0' order by l.log_id desc limit #{limit}
